name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Orders and the amended County Health Orders, members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings electronically.
Meeting can be accessed as follows:
• Channel 19 on Cox Communications
• Channel 24 on Time Warner Cable
• Channel 99 on AT&T U-Verse
• City's live webcast: https://encinitasca.gov/Government/Agendas-Webcasts
Public Comments (including oral communications and agenda item related)
Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Public Works Week Proclamation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Acting Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-05-20 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Recommendation by the Youth Commission to prohibit the sale and distribution of flavored tobacco products in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Hernandez
AMENDED RECOMMENDATION: Review the recommendation from the Youth Commission and direct staff to draft an ordinance prohibiting the sale and distribution of flavored tobacco in the City of Encinitas.
2020-05-20 Item 08C Youth Commission Recommendation to Prohibit the Sale and Distribution of Flavored Tobacco Products
8D.
Approval of Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2020/21 Pension Policy, Operating and Capital Budgets. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-32 Approving the Fiscal Year 2020/21 CalPERS Pension Policy, Operating and Capital Improvement Budgets of the Encina Wastewater Authority.
2020-05-20 Item 08D Encina FY21 Budget
8E.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2020-05, An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.27 – Expanded Polystyrene Disposable Food Service Ware, Plastic Utensil, and Beverage Straw Ordinance; Implementing Phase 3 of the City of Encinitas Plastics Initiative. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Ordinance 2020-05, titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.27 – Expanded Polystyrene Disposable Food Service Ware, Plastic Utensil, and Beverage Straw Ordinance.”
2020-05-20 Item 08E Phase 3 City of Encinitas Plastics Initiative - Ordinance Adoption
8F.
Approve resolution to complete the new MUFG Union Bank Funds Transfer Authorization (FTA)/Global Trust Services Form. Contact Person: Finance Analyst Angelini
Adopt Resolution 2020-30 “A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council authorizing the City Manager of the City of Encinitas and the Director of Finance/City Treasurer of the City of Encinitas to Take Specified Actions Related to Agreements and Accounts with MUFG Union Bank, N.A.”
2020-05-20 Item 08F Union Bank FTA Global Trust Services
8G.
Consideration of an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Encinitas Arts, Culture and Ecology Alliance (EACEA) on the Pacific View Property. Contact Person: Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Director Campbell.
Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached 90-day Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA), in substantial form subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney, with the EACEA.
2020-05-20 Item 08G Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with EACEA
8H.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2020-03, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Municipal Code Section 10.04.020 regarding Section 503.6 Security Gates. Contact Person: Acting Fire Marshal Schmidt
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2020-03, titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Municipal Code Section 10.04.020 regarding Section 503.6 Security Gates.”
2020-05-20 Item 08H Adoption of Ordinance 2020-03 Revising Security Gates
8I.
Reject All Bids for the Conservation Demonstration Garden at the Public Works Operations Center (Project). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize the City Manager to reject all bids.
2020-05-20 Item 08I City Demo Garden Reject Bids
8J.
Budget Amendment to receive the California Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) for District 76 Homeless Prevention and Intervention Funds in the amount of $250,000 for specific homelessness prevention and intervention services in the City of Encinitas in partnership with the Community Resource Center (CRC). Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Authorize the City Manager to enter into, execute and deliver a State of California Agreement accepting the funds from the State of California for the amount of $250,000; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-29 (Attachment 1) “Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” authorizing funds of $250,000 for the “Homelessness Services” CIP project.
2020-05-20 Item 08J District 76 Homeless Funds
8K.
Approval of plans and specifications, and authorization to advertise the FY 19-20 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project (CC04E and CE04H). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Approve the plans, specifications and authorize the advertisement of the FY 19-20 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project (CC04E and CE04H).
2020-05-20 Item 08K Citywide Sewer Rehab
8L.
Introduction of Ordinance 2020-08 establishing new speed limits on South Coast Highway 101. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Introduce Ordinance 2020-08 titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits on South Coast Highway.”
2020-05-20 Item 08L S101 Speed Limit Ordinance Introduction 2020-08
8M.
Public Hearing to Receive Testimony Regarding the FY 2020-21 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2020-21 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (ELLD) Annual Engineer’s Report; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-11 entitled, “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Renewing the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (Zones A, B, C, D, E, F, G & H), confirming the FY 2020-21 Engineer’s Report and ordering the transmission of charges to the County Auditor for collection”.
2020-05-20 Item 08M Public Hearing for ELLD FY 2020-21
8N.
Construction contract change order for the 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain project (CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Direct City Manager to finalize negotiations with Kevin and Radha Cummins and to execute a drainage easement for the pipe on 1691 Eolus Avenue before the City Council Meeting of June 10, 2020; and 2) Continue this agenda item to the City Council Meeting of June 10, 2020.
2020-05-20 Item 08N Change Order Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Repair - Continued from May 6, 2020
8O.
TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2020-21 Through 2024-25 Update. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the proposed projects; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-23, entitled “Resolution of the City of Encinitas Adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2021 Through 2025.”
2020-05-20 Item 08O TransNet Local Street Improvement Projects
8P.
Authorize grant application for Shared Streets Pilot Program with SANDAG. Contact Person: Acting Director of Community Development Sapa’u
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to apply for, accept and administer funding from SANDAG Shared Streets Pilot Program to assist the City of Encinitas with lane closures to facilitate the creation of safe and healthy spaces for walking, biking and other micromobility options for residents.
2020-05-20 Item 08P Authorize Grant Application Shared Streets Pilot Program - SANDAG
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 30, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, May 6, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, May 6, 2020 Special Meeting, and May 6, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-05-20 Item 08A Minutes
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Fiscal Year 2019-20 Mid-Year and Third Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments and Personnel Changes. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Mid-Year and Third Quarter Budget Status Report; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-19 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget;” and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-20 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving Personnel Changes in the Finance Department and Adopting Position Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2019-20.”
2020-05-20 Item 10A Mid-Year and Third Quarter Budget Status
10B.
City Council review and consideration of the continuation of the Jewish Family Service (JFS) Safe Parking Program at Leichtag Commons located at 441 Saxony Road for a maximum of 25 vehicles accommodating households living in their cars. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Review the Program and consider authorization of extension of the JFS Safe Parking Program. If proposing an extension of the Program, adopt Resolution No. 2020-36 “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Confirming the Existence of a Shelter Crisis and Taking Actions to Continue the Safe Parking Program.”
2020-05-20 Item 10B Safe Parking Program Review
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JUNE 10, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
